results.title: Little Fishies
results.overview: A tender drama set in Mumbai, Little Fishies follows 13-year-old Raya as she decides to break free from the suffocating atmosphere of her own father’s funeral ceremony by taking her sister to the beach — against her family’s wishes.

results.title: Within a Quiet Body
results.overview: Alex, a jaded cleaner at a gay sex club, tries to satiate his repressed desires through extreme sex.

results.title: Instinto primario
results.overview: A comedy short film about Lily, a young teacher starting out at an elementary school. There, the supervisor strives for perfection and integrity, while Lili strives for creativity and empathy. A short film that redefines what it means to inhabit a teaching space, the community, and the identity of our country.

results.title: What They Found
results.overview: The story of two soldier-cameramen, Sgt Mike Lewis and Sgt Bill Lawrie, who witnessed the liberation of Belsen during the closing days of World War II.

results.title: Twisted Fate
results.overview: Rawa, the only surviving passenger with injuries and trauma, must face the grief of Zahra, the pilot’s daughter, as well as the anger of Dita, the wife of a passenger who questions: “Why wasn’t it her husband who survived?”

results.title: Diamond Belly
results.overview: Alex’s grandfather is dying of stomach cancer. When the old man starts claiming those aren't tumours, but pilfered diamonds from a long-forgotten heist in the old country, family secrets and myths collide as Alex grapples with her newfound inheritance resting in a dying man's stomach.

results.title: TNA Bound for Glory 2025
results.overview: TNA Bound for Glory 2025 was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) that took place on October 12, 2025, at the Tsongas Center in Lowell, Massachusetts, and was headlined by Trick Williams (c) vs. Mike Santana for the TNA World Championship.

results.title: Vasiliy
results.overview: A story about twin brothers who grew in an orphanage. They promised each other that they would always be together but Kolya betrayed Vasya and left for the USA under the guise of his brother. However, brothers will meet again.

results.title: The Vulture
results.overview: Short film directed by Lenny Kraznick.

results.title: Tak Kenal Maka Taaruf
results.overview: Two rival students find their lives upended when they begin the traditional courtship process of taaruf, only for an unexpected third presence to complicate their budding relationship.

results.title: Luz
results.overview: In the neon-lit streets of Chongqing, Wei desperately searches for his estranged daughter Fa, while Hong Kong gallerist Ren grapples with her ailing stepmother Sabine in Paris. Their lives collide in a virtual reality world, where a mystical deer reveals hidden truths, sparking a journey of discovery and connection.

results.title: My Special One
results.overview: A woman who hates idols must face her past demons when she meets a famous pop star. But can she put prejudices behind her to help save his career?

results.title: Maybe I'll Find You in a Robbery
results.original_title: Tal Vez Te Encuentre En Un Asalto
results.overview: A little girl devises an innovative scheme to reconnect with her imprisoned mother during Christmas.

results.title: Surface Tension
results.overview: Competitive swimmer Bulet finds herself drowning on the day of a small town wedding.

results.title: Neera
results.overview: Neera is a heartfelt tale of love, rediscovery, and the unseen threads that bind us. it explores passion, fate, and regret - inviting us to reflect on our choices and the love we may overlook until it's out of reach.

results.title: Million
results.overview: After his wife’s death, 80‑year‑old Vavřinec Novotný feels alone and estranged from his sprawling family. He sells the family estate (Slánská hora) and announces a wild contest: whichever of his children becomes a parent first will inherit one million euros. His children and grandchildren — including a debt‑ridden restaurateur/MMA hopeful, a career‑focused singer granddaughter, and a gay grandson who longs for a family — launch into a frantic, absurd competition full of secrets, desperation and ambition. As the race unfolds, long‑buried tensions are exposed and the family learns what really matters: money or love and connection.

results.title: Simple Boy
results.overview: An instructor sees his student's inability to drive is a block tied to his father. He devises a plan to mend their fractured relationship, unlocking the young man's potential behind the wheel and helping him finally move forward.

results.title: The Queens: Quest for the Crown
results.original_title: The Queens: Quest for the Crown
results.overview: A "Miss America" for female impersonators and transgender women, the famous Miss Continental beauty pageant draws hundreds of contestants and entertainers each year as they compete for the prestigious Crown.

results.title: Anywhere, IL
results.overview: Upon a promotion request, a man struggles to leave his ever changing hometown.
